name: Pretty Mahjong Soldier Mu
source: Space aliens come to earth and turn an ordinary Sailor Moon look-alike into a magical mahjongg girl. You then play several opponents in mahjongg, who look like they've been ripped from other animes. Relatively easy as far as mahjongg games go.
translation: 外星人来到地球，将一个长得像水手月亮的普通女孩，变成了魔法麻将少女。随后，你将与多名对手打麻将，她们看起来仿佛是从其他动画里直接搬来的。以麻将游戏而言，本作相对容易上手。
